functions.name: Utils.sleep
functions.description: Returns a Promise that resolves after the given number of milliseconds, for delaying subsequent actions.

functions.name: Utils.cleanStr
functions.description: Strips Hungarian accented characters from a string, replacing them with their unaccented ASCII equivalents.

functions.name: Utils.clone
functions.description: Returns a shallow or deep copy of an object/array.

functions.name: Utils.replaceAll
functions.description: Case-insensitively replaces every key of a {find: replace} map inside a string.

functions.name: Utils.scrollTop
functions.description: Smoothly scrolls the whole page back to the top.

functions.name: Utils.getRandomId
functions.description: Returns a cryptographically random 32-bit integer, useful as a unique id.

functions.name: Utils.toTitleCase
functions.description: Converts a string to Title Case (capitalizes the first letter of each word).

functions.name: Utils.convertValueToPost
functions.description: Parses a locale-formatted numeric string (handling a trailing '%') into a plain number ready to post to the server.

functions.name: Utils.getToday
functions.description: Returns today's date formatted as Year{delimiter}Month{delimiter}Day.

functions.name: Utils.rewindTime
functions.description: Mutates a Date to midnight (00:00:00.000) of the same day.

functions.name: Utils.forwardTime
functions.description: Mutates a Date to the last moment (23:59:59.999) of the same day.

functions.name: Utils.escapeText
functions.description: JSON-escapes a string's special characters (quotes, backslashes) without the surrounding quotes.

functions.name: Utils.formatIntForChart
functions.description: Formats an integer with thin-space thousands separators, for chart axis/label display.

functions.name: Utils.addLeadingZero
functions.description: Pads a single-digit number with a leading zero (e.g. 5 -> "05").

functions.name: Utils.scrollTo
functions.description: Smoothly scrolls to a widget (by id or jQuery object), firing a 'refresh.<id>' event first.

functions.name: Utils.parseNumber
functions.description: Parses a locale-formatted number string (negative parentheses, thousands separators, exponents) into a JS number.

functions.name: Utils.replaceDecimal
functions.description: Formats a number's decimal separator ('.') to the given locale's own decimal character.

functions.name: Utils.getTimestamp
functions.description: Returns an ISO-like timestamp for a date string, rounded to the start (or end, if forwardTime) of that day.

functions.name: Utils.getFormattedDate
functions.description: Formats a Date as Year{delimiter}Month{delimiter}Day, optionally appending HH:MM:SS.

functions.name: Utils.precisionRound
functions.description: Rounds a number to the given decimal precision, optionally returned as a fixed-format string.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableId
functions.description: Extracts the GridTable widget id from a composite cell id string ("tableId,row,col").

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableCurrentCell
functions.description: Returns the cell data object at a GridTable's currently selected row/column.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableCurrentRow
functions.description: Returns the full row of cell data at a GridTable's currently selected row.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableCell
functions.description: Returns one cell from a GridTable's currently selected row, by column index.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableCellByRowAndColumn
functions.description: Returns a specific GridTable cell (or one of its properties) by explicit row/column.

functions.name: Utils.getCheckedGridTableCellByRowAndColumn
functions.description: Same as getGridTableCellByRowAndColumn but returns false if the row/column/property is out of bounds or missing.

functions.name: Utils.setAndGetGridTableSystemValueByCurrentRow
functions.description: Copies one property of the current row's cell into a systemValue and returns it.

functions.name: Utils.getDropBoxSelectedItem
functions.description: Returns the full item object currently selected in a DropBox widget.

functions.name: Utils.selectDropBoxNextItem
functions.description: Selects the next item in a DropBox's list, if one exists.

functions.name: Utils.selectDropBoxPreviousItem
functions.description: Selects the previous item in a DropBox's list, if one exists.

functions.name: Utils.getDropBoxSelectedItemAttribute
functions.description: Returns one named attribute of a DropBox's currently selected item.

functions.name: Utils.getCellsFromClipboard
functions.description: Parses a widget's pasted clipboard text into a 2D array of rows/columns (tab/newline separated).

functions.name: Utils.getArrayWithValues
functions.description: Builds an array of the given length, every element set to the same value.

functions.name: Utils.getOrdinalValuePairs
functions.description: Builds a TM1-style {Ordinal, Value} JSON pair list from parallel ordinal and value arrays.

functions.name: Utils.getOrdinalValuePairsAndEmptyFilledValues
functions.description: Same as getOrdinalValuePairs but pads missing trailing values with empty strings using existingValues' ordinals.

functions.name: Utils.isGridTableLoaded
functions.description: Returns true if a GridTable widget currently has cell data loaded.

functions.name: Utils.getCellsByColumnsFromClipboard
functions.description: Extracts one column's values from a widget's pasted clipboard data.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableActualAndLastPage
functions.description: Returns {actualPage, maxPage} for a paged GridTable.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTablePagerText
functions.description: Returns a "current/total" page label string for a paged GridTable.

functions.name: Utils.isGridTablePagerPreviousButtonVisible
functions.description: Returns true if a paged GridTable is not on its first page.

functions.name: Utils.isGridTablePagerNextButtonVisible
functions.description: Returns true if a paged GridTable is not on its last page.

functions.name: Utils.isValueExistingAndNotEmpty
functions.description: Returns true if a widget's given value field exists and is non-empty.

functions.name: Utils.setWidgetValueIfNotExist
functions.description: Sets a systemValue only if it doesn't already exist.

functions.name: Utils.setWidgetValueIfNotExistByOther
functions.description: Copies one systemValue's value into another only if the target doesn't already exist.

functions.name: Utils.setWidgetValue
functions.description: Sets a systemValue/widget entry directly (resets it if the value is falsy and it's a live Widget instance).

functions.name: Utils.setWidgetValueByOther
functions.description: Copies one systemValue's current value into another.

functions.name: Utils.getPropertyOrFunctionValue
functions.description: Returns object[property], calling it first if it is itself a function.

functions.name: Utils.getDecimalFromPercentString
functions.description: Converts a percentage string (e.g. "42%") into a 0-1 decimal, optionally locale-formatted.

functions.name: Utils.filterUnique
functions.description: Returns an array with duplicate values removed, preserving order.

functions.name: Utils.getEvenElements
functions.description: Returns every array element at an even index (0, 2, 4, ...).

functions.name: Utils.getOddElements
functions.description: Returns every array element at an odd index (1, 3, 5, ...).

functions.name: Utils.getArrayElements
functions.description: Returns every array element whose index modulo `modulo` equals `tailings`.

functions.name: Utils.modifyFileName
functions.description: Renames the file currently attached to a FileUpload widget, keeping its original extension.

functions.name: Utils.buildProcessParameters
functions.description: Builds a TM1 process-parameters JSON body from an array of {name, value} pairs.

functions.name: Utils.buildProcessParametersFromObject
functions.description: Same as buildProcessParameters but built from a plain {name: value} object.

functions.name: Utils.getProcessNameValuePair
functions.description: Builds one {name, value} pair object for use with buildProcessParameters.

functions.name: Utils.getHorizontalTableHiddenValue
functions.description: Reads a hidden value from a horizontal table's currently active row/column.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableRowCol
functions.description: Splits a composite GridTable cell id ("table_row_col") into its {row, column, id} parts.

functions.name: Utils.openPopup
functions.description: Opens a popup, resolving the triggering event/element from the behavior context (ctx). This is the real Studio convention for opening a popup from a widget event - not Api.openPopup.

functions.name: Utils.togglePopup
functions.description: Toggles a popup open/closed, resolving event/element from ctx. This is the real Studio convention for toggling a popup from a widget event - not Api.togglePopup.

functions.name: Utils.closePopup
functions.description: Closes a popup, resolving event/element from ctx. This is the real Studio convention for closing a popup from a widget event - not Api.closePopup.

functions.name: Utils.closePopups
functions.description: Closes multiple popups by id.

functions.name: Utils.getMatrixFromArray
functions.description: Splits a flat array into a 2D matrix with a fixed number of columns per row.

functions.name: Utils.getGridtableMatrix
functions.description: Same as getMatrixFromArray, then maps every cell through a given function.

functions.name: Utils.focus
functions.description: Focuses an input (by id or jQuery object), optionally moving the cursor to the end of its text.

functions.name: Utils.separatesThousands
functions.description: Formats a number's integer part with thousands separators, preserving any decimal part.

functions.name: Utils.saveGridTableToggles
functions.description: Snapshots one column's toggle/value state across every row of a GridTable into a systemValue.

functions.name: Utils.getGridTableToggleValue
functions.description: Reads back one row's saved toggle value from saveGridTableToggles' systemValue.

functions.name: Utils.hexToRgb
functions.description: Converts a hex color string to an rgb()/rgba() CSS string, or an {r,g,b,a} object.

functions.name: Utils.getActiveUserString
functions.description: Normalizes a username string (leaves CAM IDs as-is, converts backslashes to forward slashes otherwise).

functions.name: Utils.undefinedOrFalse
functions.description: Returns true if a value is undefined or exactly false.

functions.name: Utils.getNavigationUrl
functions.description: Builds the current page's URL with an optional base64-encoded parameters query string.

functions.name: Utils.enableRequestLogger
functions.description: Turns on the framework's request logger.

functions.name: Utils.disableRequestLogger
functions.description: Turns off the framework's request logger.

functions.name: Utils.isRequestLoggerEnabled
functions.description: Returns true if the request logger is currently enabled.

functions.name: Utils.setRequestLoggerJourneyId
functions.description: Sets the current request-logger journey id.

functions.name: Utils.generateRequestLoggerJourneyId
functions.description: Generates and sets a new random request-logger journey id.

functions.name: Utils.getRequestLoggerJourneyId
functions.description: Returns the current request-logger journey id.

functions.name: Utils.setRequestLoggerGroupId
functions.description: Sets the current request-logger group id.

functions.name: Utils.generateRequestLoggerGroupId
functions.description: Generates and sets a new random request-logger group id.

functions.name: Utils.getRequestLoggerGroupId
functions.description: Returns the current request-logger group id.

functions.name: Utils.enableToolTips
functions.description: Enables hover tooltips for widgets/segments that declare one.

functions.name: Utils.disableToolTips
functions.description: Disables hover tooltips (must have been enabled first).

functions.name: Utils.reloadApp
functions.description: Reloads the current browser page/app from scratch.

functions.name: Utils.getAppSubPathArray
functions.description: Returns the URL path segments up to and including the app's own instance name.

functions.name: Utils.getAppSubPath
functions.description: Returns the app's sub-path (getAppSubPathArray joined with '/').

functions.name: Utils.getFullUrlForAjax
functions.description: Resolves a relative URL into a full instance-aware URL when the app is running under URL-based navigation.

functions.name: Utils.getInstanceUrl
functions.description: Builds a full URL for the given sub-path under the app's own instance origin.

functions.name: Utils.isUrlNavigation
functions.description: Returns true if the app is running in URL-path-based navigation mode (vs. the default single-path mode).

functions.name: Utils.getAppProviderBasedUrl
functions.description: Prefixes a URL with the current auth provider's sub-path when in URL-navigation mode.

functions.name: Utils.changeUrlState
functions.description: Updates the browser URL/history to reflect a new page (and any extra path segments as navigation parameters) without a full reload.

functions.name: Utils.changePageTitleAndFavicon
functions.description: Sets both the browser tab title and favicon in one call.

functions.name: Utils.changePageFavicon
functions.description: Sets the browser tab's favicon image.

functions.name: Utils.changePageTitle
functions.description: Sets the browser tab's title text.

functions.name: Utils.parseJSONScript
functions.description: Parses the JSON text content of a <script> element by id into an object (returns {} on error).

functions.name: Utils.setAutoPosition
functions.description: Positions a floating element (e.g. a dropdown/popup) next to an anchor element, auto-picking the side with the most free screen space.

functions.name: Utils.adjustHeightsToMax
functions.description: Sets every element in a jQuery collection to the height of the tallest one among them.

functions.name: Utils.buildMdxQueryUrl
functions.description: Appends OData-style $top/$skip/$count paging parameters to an MDX Cells/Tuples query URL, computed from pagination options and the event context's extra params.

functions.name: Utils.calculateMargin
functions.description: Resolves a margin that may be a percentage string, a 0-1 fraction, or an absolute number, into an absolute value relative to a total.

functions.name: Utils.checkScreenResolution
functions.description: Shows a one-time warning popup if the browser window is narrower than the app's actual content width.

functions.name: Utils.create_UUID
functions.description: Generates a random RFC-4122-style UUID string.

functions.name: Utils.extCall
functions.description: Calls a named custom extension function registered under ExtensionFunctions.

functions.name: Utils.getSize
functions.description: Formats a numeric or percentage size value as a CSS length string (px or %), optionally converting % to px.

functions.name: Utils.htmlEncode
functions.description: HTML-escapes a string's quote characters (" and ') for safe embedding in an HTML attribute (a numeric input is returned unchanged).

functions.name: Utils.isInViewport
functions.description: Returns true if a DOM element is fully visible within the current browser viewport.

functions.name: Utils.isMobile
functions.description: Returns true if the current browser's user agent looks like a mobile device (cached after the first check).

functions.name: Utils.nl2br
functions.description:
Converts newline characters in a string to '
' tags.

functions.name: Utils.parseFormatStringToCSSClasses
functions.description: Converts a dash-separated format string into space-separated positional CSS classes ('c-0-x c-1-y ...').

functions.name: Utils.stopEvent
functions.description: Prevents an event's default action and stops it propagating further; returns the event.

functions.name: Utils.stripHtml
functions.description: Removes HTML tags from a string (a numeric input is returned unchanged).

functions.name: Utils.transformMdxResponseToGridTableLight
functions.description: Reshapes a raw MDX Cells response into a GridTable-ready {columns, content} row/column structure, auto-detecting which member dimension represents columns.
